# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were applied in this stage. The prior review approved the per-tick N/C/O2 budget ledger implementation without actionable amendments, so the code remains as produced in the implement stage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the validation output and confirmed the implementation was approved with no required amendments.
2. [Completed] Verified that no code edits were necessary for the budget ledger, canonical total helpers, or associated tests.
3. [Skipped] Rerun validation after applying fixes.

## Validation Evidence

- Review outcome was `approved` with no follow-up amendments or blocking findings.
- Existing validation remains applicable because no code changed in this stage: `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` passed.
- Existing validation remains applicable because no code changed in this stage: `cargo test -p tank_core --test water_change_mass_balance` passed.
- Existing validation remains applicable because no code changed in this stage: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` suite.
- Review evidence also recorded `cargo clippy -p tank_core` with zero warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- Canonical live-biomass C/N totals still depend on shared stoichiometric helper assumptions in `types/budget.rs`; if future phases add new explicit element-bearing fields or refine biomass composition, those helpers and tests must be updated together.
- The closed-system conservation checks use a quiescent no-growth scenario. Richer gameplay states may still expose pre-existing stoichiometry gaps in systems that do not yet move every element explicitly, but the new ledger makes those imbalances inspectable.
- No compile-time coverage guard exists for newly added element-bearing state fields; helper completeness still relies on the canonical helper tests being kept in sync with state evolution.
